meta.note: Manual CSO — /cso skill not available in this runtime; findings are equivalent in scope.

findings.title: Git history contains live secrets (BFG scrub pending)
findings.description: backend/.env.bak-20260510-094647 was tracked and contains live EMR credentials, Flask SECRET_KEY, and OpenAI API key. File removed from HEAD in commit 8d6c2ab but BFG history scrub has not been run.
findings.recommendation: Run BFG immediately. Rotate all three secrets. Force-push. Re-clone all local copies.

findings.title: OAuth callback URLs with auth codes shipped to debug log
findings.description: clerk-tap.js logs location.href (up to 800 chars) at page load. Clerk OAuth redirects contain code= and state= params. console-shipper.js intercepts and ships to /api/debug-log.
findings.recommendation: Redact code=, state=, session_token= from URL before logging.

findings.title: Console shipper can exfiltrate clinical data (LGPD risk)
findings.description: console-shipper.js ships console.warn/error payloads (up to 4000 chars) to /api/debug-log. Content scripts log SOAP text, patient URLs, and CID codes at warn level. Patient clinical data may appear in backend logs.
findings.recommendation: Add PII scrubber: truncate to 200 chars, redact CID patterns, strip URL query params.

findings.title: Auth token loaded into content-script memory unnecessarily
findings.description: content/api-client.js loads authToken and refreshToken from chrome.storage.local into module-level variables. The SW proxy pattern already handles token attachment — content scripts don't need the token in memory.
findings.recommendation: Remove chrome.storage.local.get([authToken, refreshToken]) from api-client.js. All auth-sensitive requests should go through the SW proxy.

findings.title: cookies permission broader than required
findings.description: The cookies permission grants full read/write access to cookies on matched hosts including the G-Hosp EMR domain. No extension JS directly calls chrome.cookies.*.
findings.recommendation: Audit if Clerk SDK strictly requires cookies permission. Remove if possible.

findings.title: style-src unsafe-inline in extension CSP
findings.description: Extension pages allow inline styles via unsafe-inline. Widens XSS attack surface if user-supplied content is rendered as inline styles.
findings.recommendation: Document which component requires unsafe-inline. Track a ticket to remove when component refactored to class-based styles.

findings.title: Dev-only host permissions in production manifest
findings.description: manifest.json includes http://localhost:5050/*, http://127.0.0.1:5050/*, and http://100.97.14.32:5050/*. These should be absent from the Chrome Web Store build.
findings.recommendation: Verify manifest.prod.json omits these. Add CWS pre-submission checklist item.

findings.title: API discovery URL is a GitHub Gist (single point of failure)
findings.description: API_DISCOVERY_URL points to a Gist that controls the production API endpoint. Account compromise or accidental Gist deletion could redirect all traffic.
findings.recommendation: Mirror at api.tocafichadr.com.br/config/api-url.json. Use Gist only as fallback.

findings.title: Auth token expiry not validated on load from chrome.storage.local
findings.description: authToken is restored from storage without expiry check. Stale tokens could be sent if Clerk SDK rotation fails silently.
findings.recommendation: Store authTokenExpiry alongside authToken. Treat token as absent if within 60s of expiry.

findings.title: *.trycloudflare.com wildcard host permission
findings.description: Any Cloudflare Tunnel URL matches this host permission. Intended for dev tunnels but is effectively an open wildcard for the Cloudflare tunnel namespace.
findings.recommendation: Restrict to specific known tunnel hostnames for production, or document the accepted risk.

findings.title: No default handler for unknown message types in SW
findings.description: SW message handler has no catch-all for unknown message types. Callers waiting for a response to an unrecognized message type will hang indefinitely.
findings.recommendation: Add default case: sendResponse({ ok: false, error: 'unknown_message_type' }); return true;

findings.title: Offscreen document lifecycle not guarded against orphaned contexts
findings.description: No check for chrome.offscreen.hasDocument() before sending messages to the offscreen doc. SW restart or Chrome idle can orphan the context.
findings.recommendation: Add chrome.offscreen.hasDocument() guard and recreate document if absent.

findings.title: VAD setInterval not cleared on content-script unload (navigation)
findings.description: The VAD polling interval is cleared by _vadTeardown() on stop, but not on window unload during active recording.
findings.recommendation: window.addEventListener('beforeunload', _vadTeardown) to ensure cleanup on navigation.

findings.title: user-config-client.js fallback API URL is localhost
findings.description: _resolveApiBase() falls back to http://127.0.0.1:5050 if chrome.storage.sync read fails. In production this silently breaks config hydration.
findings.recommendation: Change fallback to https://api.tocafichadr.com.br to match DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL in service-worker.src.js.

findings.title: popup.bundle.js committed to repo (build artifact)
findings.description: .gitignore lists popup/popup.bundle.js as ignored but git ls-files shows it tracked. Build artifacts inflate repo size and cause noisy diffs.

findings.title: _normalizeApiError duplicated in SW and api-client
findings.description: Identical function defined in both background/service-worker.src.js and content/api-client.js. Drift risk.

findings.title: package.json name is stale (pedbot-extension)
findings.description: Rebrand to tocafichadr missed package.json. Harmless at runtime.

findings.title: vercel.json in extension repo
findings.description: Vercel deployment config is present in the Chrome extension repo. Unclear if this is for a companion service or was copied by mistake.
findings.recommendation: Verify and move to the correct repo if applicable.
